name: Choice log
summary: Writes every choice made in Cull to a file as it is saved.
description: Follows GET /api/events and appends one line of JSON for each keep, remove or heart to choices.jsonl beside this file. It carries on from the last choice it wrote after a restart.
author: Daddy Cull
needs: Python 3.9 or later, running follow.py beside this file
work: Appends each choice to choices.jsonl as it is saved
